title: Nucleic Acid Purification
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing the magnetic module in slot 4, the temperature module in slot 1, and the two 12‑channel reservoirs as indicated.

steps.title: Calibrate labware
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App and the calibration tips described in the support article.

steps.title: Load lysed samples
steps.instruction: Dispense the lysed samples into a NEST 96‑deepwell plate positioned on the magnetic module (slot 4).

steps.title: Prepare reagent layout
steps.instruction: Place the binding buffer, magnetic beads, wash solutions, and elution solution in the two 12‑channel reservoirs according to the Setup layout.

steps.title: Add binding buffer and beads
steps.instruction: Add the binding buffer and magnetic beads to each sample well as defined in the protocol.

steps.title: Wash magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Perform two consecutive bead‑wash steps using the magnetic module, following the protocol’s wash parameters.

steps.title: Elute to chilled PCR plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate to a chilled PCR plate on the temperature module (slot 1), preserving the well‑to‑well mapping (A1→A1, B1→B1, … D2→D2).

steps.title: Configure tip handling
steps.instruction: Set protocol parameters: park tips = yes (recommended), track tips across runs = yes or no as desired, flash = yes or no.
